_note: Hand-verified component targeting that WINS over scripts/derive_ability_aoe.py. Use this whenever a single ability splits into components with different target counts, or when the tooltip text lies. Everything here is component-keyed: champion -> slot -> component name, exactly as the component is named in data/ability_formulas.json.

Drunken Rage Empowered Attack._why: The derivation keeps empowered basic attacks primary-only, because most of them simply hit the body being attacked. Drunken Rage is the exception: the empowered attack splashes around the target, so it belongs on the area axis.

Shell Impact._why: The shell itself is a single-target collision; only the explosion behind it spreads.

Cone Explosion._why: The cone opens BEHIND the first champion hit, so it cannot touch the primary target.
